verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows currency detection in receipt scanning and multi-currency invoicing, but contains no documentation of a built-in global reimbursement/payout mechanism that pays employees abroad in local currency without a separate international payments process. Missing for 10: any mention of Expensify's own global reimbursement/ACH-to-local-currency payout feature, supported countries/currencies for payouts, or evidence it avoids third-party payment rails.
